# Submission deliverables

Regenerate everything from source — nothing here is maintained by hand:

```bash
python scripts/build_pdf.py                       # all four PDFs
node scripts/build_deck.js dist/Mycroft_AI_Business_Proposal_Deck.pptx
```

`build_deck.js` needs `pptxgenjs` (`npm install pptxgenjs`); `build_pdf.py` needs
the `markdown` package and any Chrome/Chromium on the machine.

| File | What it is | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `Mycroft_AI_Business_Proposal.pdf` | The business proposal as a document — the Round 2 written deliverable | `docs/BUSINESS_PROPOSAL.md` |
| `Mycroft_AI_Business_Proposal_Deck.pptx` | The same proposal as 17 editable slides | `scripts/build_deck.js` |
| `Mycroft_AI_Business_Proposal_Deck.pdf` | The deck as a PDF, for uploading where PowerPoint is not accepted | exported from the `.pptx` |
| `Mycroft_AI_README.pdf` | Repository overview and measured results | `README.md` |
| `Mycroft_AI_Methodology.pdf` | How every detector works and where it fails | `docs/METHODOLOGY.md` |
| `Mycroft_AI_Assumptions.pdf` | Every number: measured, simulated or assumed | `docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md` |

Every figure in these documents comes from `outputs/`, which is regenerated by
`python scripts/run_eval.py` and `python scripts/run_demo.py`.
